title.narrative: Advancing evidence-based policies and actions, and supporting policy making to enhance the contribution of culture and creative sectors and industries to sustainable development

description.narrative: Contract related to: Advancing evidence-based policies and actions, and supporting policy making to enhance the contribution of culture and creative sectors and industries to sustainable development - Human development is at the core of our multilateral commitment towards achieving the SDGs by 2030 and leaving no one behind. This means taking a human rights based approach to guarantee that all individuals can be healthy and thrive and can have equal opportunities. Investing in the future of people and human development is also investing in children and in youth, as key agents of development and, as such, essential contributors to the 2030 Agenda, including through their ability to innovate.The overall objective of this action is to increase the effectiveness of the human development aspects of our programmes at global, regional and country level. The specific objective (SO) is the provision of expertise and production of new knowledge in the areas of the human rights based approach, mainstreaming of inequality reduction and gender equality, youth and children participation and empowerment, health and social protection programmes, and education and culture programmes.With the support of these facilities the implementation of both the human rights based approach and the Gender Action Plan will be strengthened. Inequality-reduction will be mainstreamed in all and at all levels of our interventions. A people centred approach with a focus on marginalized groups such as people with disabilities will be applied. The attainment of quality education worldwide, universal health care and universal social protection coverage will be accelerated. Opportunities to strengthen humanitarian-development-peace nexus will be sought. Insofar the youth component is concerned, the facility will reinforce our work on children and youth at all levels and focus more particularly on the Youth Action Plan and the reinforcement of youth and children participation and empowerment. The support on culture will strengthen our work with and for cultural and creative sectors and contribute to promote cultural diversity and intercultural dialogueThe technical assistance and expertise provided through the Knowledge Hub for Human Development will contribute to making progress towards many of the SDGs such as ending poverty (SDG 1) and hunger (SDG 2), good health and well-being (SDG 3), quality education (SDG 4), achieving gender equality (SDG 5), decent work and economic growth (SDG 8) and reducing inequalities (SDG 10).
